title: Feature event log line
description: Contract for one line of specs/NNN-feature/events.jsonl (one JSON object per line, append-only). Codifies the shapes previously described only in prose in .claude/docs/agent-coordination.md. The type discriminator is `event`; `event_type` is a historical alias seen on `declined` events and is accepted. `checkpoint` is added here so cost and catch metrics can be attributed to a stage. `defect-found` is the outcome-feedback slot: it is not emitted yet, and the measurement backbone treats catch-by-stage as a process proxy until it is. Permissive on purpose (additionalProperties true) so events written before this schema existed still validate; the backbone reads defensively rather than rejecting history.

event_type.description: Historical alias for `event` (seen on `declined`). Accepted; `event` is preferred.

agent.description: Agent name as registered in .claude/agents/, or the producer of the event.

checkpoint.description: Artifact-boundary checkpoint the event belongs to. Added in Phase B so cost and catch metrics attribute to a stage. C4 is the checkpoint code the dispatcher emits for the pre-commit stage; pre-commit is its manifest name. Both are accepted.

invocation_id.description: Unique ID (ULID preferred); matches the artifact frontmatter.

status.description: informational (no items raised) or pending-resolution (items requiring closure).

artifact.description: Filename produced, relative to the feature directory.

linked_artifacts.description: Files the agent read during this invocation.

references.description: Upstream invocation_id this work builds on, else null.

items_raised.description: Items raised requiring closure. Objects with id and priority; an empty array means none.

parallel_group_id.description: ULID-prefixed identifier shared by events in the same parallel batch.

cost.description: Token counts and estimated USD for the invocation.

routing.description: On routing-decision events: plan (deterministic plan lookup) or light/full (fallback FIT risk gate).

assignments.description: On routing-decision plan events: per-agent catalog slices.

catalogs_consulted.description: On consultation-evidence events: catalogs the agent actually read.

rules_examined.description: On consultation-evidence events: rules examined (list or count).

closure_evidence.description: Evidence payload for closure events. For closure-verified events the disk-truth gate (verify_loop_closure.py) requires a `read` block whose path resolves to a real non-empty artifact and whose sha256 is the digest the verifier actually read; a closure-verified lacking valid read evidence is auto-rejected at commit time. `read` is intentionally NOT required at the schema level so historical events without it still validate; the requirement is enforced by the gate for closure-verified specifically, not by schema validation.

location.description: file:line or path of the cited evidence (human-facing pointer).

read.description: Disk-truth read evidence. REQUIRED on closure-verified events. Records the artifact the verifier independently read so the commit-time gate can re-read it.

path.description: Repo-root-relative path to the artifact that was read.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the artifact at read time.

bytes.description: Size in bytes at read time (optional).

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the read (optional).

caught_at.description: On defect-found events (outcome layer, not yet emitted): the checkpoint that caught the defect, or null if it escaped.

escaped_to.description: On defect-found events: where the defect surfaced if it escaped (for example a later checkpoint, post-merge, or production), else null.

severity.description: On defect-found events: severity of the escaped or caught defect.
